mapper.select: SELECT id, name, contact_phone FROM elder_info WHERE (is_deleted IS NULL OR is_deleted = 0) AND status = 1 AND name = #{elderName} AND contact_phone = #{phone} LIMIT 1

SELECT ei.id, ei.name, ei.contact_phone AS contactPhone, ei.age, ei.gender, ei.health_status AS healthStatus, ei.status FROM family_elder_binding feb INNER JOIN elder_info ei ON ei.id = feb.elder_id WHERE feb.family_member_id = #{familyMemberId} AND feb.status = 1 AND (feb.is_deleted IS NULL OR feb.is_deleted = 0) AND (ei.is_deleted IS NULL OR ei.is_deleted = 0)
AND ei.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%')
ORDER BY feb.create_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE family_elder_binding SET status = 0, is_deleted = 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE family_member_id = #{familyMemberId} AND elder_id = #{elderId} AND status = 1 AND (is_deleted IS NULL OR is_deleted = 0)
mapper.select: SELECT elder_id FROM family_elder_binding WHERE family_member_id = #{familyMemberId} AND status = 1 AND (is_deleted IS NULL OR is_deleted = 0) ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT 1
